claim: The pipeline handles one document at a time; a document belongs to one collection and came from one source item identified by a URI and a content hash.
A document is split into pages (when the format has them) and into chunks of a configurable token size with page anchors; chunks carry dense vectors.
Pattern extractors produce email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, money amounts, dates, legal references and hashtags; NER produces persons, organisations, places and events.
Every tag written to the index and the graph carries the pack id, the pack version and the stage that produced it, with a confidence and character spans.
prov:Activity, prov:Entity and prov:wasGeneratedBy describe how an entity was produced by an activity.
dcterms:title, dcterms:created, dcterms:modified and dcterms:language are the standard document metadata terms.
skos:Concept and skos:ConceptScheme are the units of a controlled vocabulary.
